description: Source code for the ElementHandle class in Playwright, providing methods to interact with DOM elements, handle files, take screenshots, and query elements.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a DOM element, providing methods for interaction, querying, and file uploads.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an ElementHandle instance from a channel handle.

methods.name: fromNullable

methods.description: Returns the frame that owns this element handle.

methods.description: Returns the content frame if the element is an iframe.
